# EXEED UAE

> > Official EXEED automotive website for UAE featuring electric vehicles, plug-in hybrids, and SUVs distributed by Al Ghurair Motors across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the GCC region.

EXEED UAE is the official platform for EXEED vehicles in the United Arab Emirates, operated by Al Ghurair Motors (AG Auto Trading LLC). The site showcases EXEED's lineup of electric vehicles (EXLANTIX series), plug-in hybrids (RX PHEV), and premium SUVs (VX, LX, TXL), alongside service centers, corporate fleet programs, and certified pre-owned vehicles across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and other Emirates.

## Key Topics

- EXEED electric vehicles (EVs)
- EXLANTIX electric series
- RX plug-in hybrid (PHEV)
- Al Ghurair Motors distribution
- Dubai and Abu Dhabi showrooms
- VX, LX, TXL SUV models
- GCC specifications
- Certified pre-owned vehicles
- Corporate fleet management
- Service and maintenance centers
- Extended warranty programs
- Test drive experiences
- Chery automotive partnership
- Dubai Autodrome events
- UAE dealership network
